body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Move up to 2 units toward existing cover or concealment. If none is available, move 1 unit instead.

surges.html: Suppress an ordinary Slowed Condition during this movement.

rider.title: Contingency - Evasion
rider.html: When an enemy enters a space adjacent to your destination, you may move 1 unit farther into cover without triggering its movement Reactions.
